strategy.offer: Integrated machinery, automation software, engineering, and service for planning, equipping, controlling, monitoring, and operating water, wastewater, flood-control, and related energy infrastructure.
strategy.customers: Municipalities, utilities, infrastructure operators, associations, and engineering planners responsible for building, modernizing, and safely operating public water, wastewater, and energy systems.
strategy.why_we_win: It promises tailored end-to-end solutions, open interoperable technology, transparent service, and responsibility for outcomes beyond delivery, supported by extensive practical project experience.
strategy.resources: Engineering development, proprietary products, standardized yet flexible IT modules, documented know-how from thousands of projects, service portals, and a multidisciplinary workforce.
strategy.direction: It is heading toward broader digital networking of infrastructure assets for intelligent system-wide control, simpler operations, higher efficiency, and environmental protection, including energy recovery.
